bug_description.original: Crash Type: Heap-use-after-free READ 8 Crash State: pixcmapDestroy colorquant_fuzzer.cc pixcmapDestroy
bug_description.normalized: In the colorquant_fuzzer harness, pixGetColormap(pix1) returns a non-owning raw pointer to pix1's internal PIXCMAP. The PIXCMAP is allocated during pixColorGray's in-place 4bpp-to-8bpp conversion via pixcmapCreate(8) in pixcmapConvertTo8, then assigned to pix1 through pixTransferAllData. When pixDestroy(&pix1) is called during cleanup, the colormap is freed through pix1's ownership chain (pixFree -> pixDestroyColormap -> pixcmapDestroy). The subsequent explicit pixcmapDestroy(&cmap) at line 48 dereferences the dangling pointer, reading 8 bytes (cmap->array) from the freed 24-byte PIXCMAP struct.

source.description: First project-code read of attacker-controlled fuzzer input. pixDeserializeFromMemory parses the SPIX-format byte stream into width, height, depth, and ncolors, then materializes a PIX object. The PIX flows into the harness as pixs and is processed through pixThresholdTo4bpp, pixColorGray, and cleanup, where the UAF occurs.
source.value_from: Attacker-controlled raw bytes passed from LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput via pixReadMemSpix; the SPIX format encodes image dimensions and pixel data directly from the fuzzer buffer.

sink.description: Reads cmap->array (8 bytes) from the freed PIXCMAP struct. Called from colorquant_fuzzer.cc:48 via pixcmapDestroy(&cmap) with a dangling pointer. The PIXCMAP was already freed by pixDestroy(&pix1) through pixFree -> pixDestroyColormap -> pixcmapDestroy at colormap.c:292-293.

root_cause.description: Destroys pix1 and its colormap via pixFree -> pixDestroyColormap -> pixcmapDestroy. The fuzzer's local cmap variable, obtained earlier via pixGetColormap(pix1), still holds a pointer to the now-freed PIXCMAP. No mechanism nullifies external aliases. The fix removes the redundant pixcmapDestroy(&cmap) call at line 48 since pixDestroy already handles colormap cleanup through ownership.

tainted_value_origin.description: The image dimensions and pixel data originate from the attacker-controlled SPIX byte stream. The deserialized PIX object flows through the harness and triggers the colormap allocation and double-free cleanup path.

parser_admitted.description: After the SPIX magic bytes check passes (id[0]=='s', id[1]=='p', id[2]=='i', id[3]=='x') and size/dimension sanity checks succeed, the input is parsed into a PIX object returned to the harness.

coarse_trace.summary: Parses attacker SPIX-format bytes into a PIX object with image dimensions, optional colormap, and pixel data.
Creates 4bpp pix1 from pixs, calls pixColorGray which replaces pix1's colormap via in-place 4bpp-to-8bpp conversion, obtains a non-owning cmap alias via pixGetColormap(pix1).

Allocates a new PIXCMAP struct during the in-place conversion chain (pixColorGrayCmap -> pixConvertTo8 -> pixConvert4To8 -> pixcmapConvertTo8 -> pixcmapCreate(8)). This PIXCMAP replaces pix1's old colormap.
Destroys pix1 via pixFree -> pixDestroyColormap -> pixcmapDestroy, freeing the PIXCMAP struct and its array. The external cmap alias becomes dangling.
Called explicitly with the dangling cmap pointer from the fuzzer cleanup at line 48. Reads cmap->array (8 bytes) from the freed PIXCMAP struct — heap-use-after-free READ 8.

fine_trace.note: First read of attacker-controlled data in project code. Parses SPIX header fields (w, h, d, ncolors) from the raw byte buffer, then creates a PIX object with pixCreate(w, h, d) and optional colormap. Returns the materialized PIX to the harness as pixs.

Creates 4bpp PIX pix1 with a colormap (cmapflag=1). The colormap at depth 4 causes pixColorGray to dispatch to pixColorGrayCmap at coloring.c:260, which performs an in-place depth conversion replacing the colormap.

Allocates a new 24-byte PIXCMAP struct for 8bpp depth. Called from pixcmapConvertTo8 (colormap.c:1684) during the chain: pixColorGray (coloring.c:260) -> pixColorGrayCmap (paintcmap.c) -> pixConvertTo8 -> pixConvert4To8 (pixconv.c:2569) -> pixcmapConvertTo8 -> pixcmapCreate(8). After return, pixTransferAllData (pix1.c:931) replaces pix1's old colormap with this new one (old freed via pixSetColormap -> pixDestroyColormap), making pix1 the sole owner.
reachability_checkpoints: pix1 has colormap -> pixColorGray dispatches to pixColorGrayCmap (coloring.c:260)
pix1 depth == 4 -> pixColorGrayCmap enters conversion branch (paintcmap.c:356-358)
cmaps non-NULL in pixConvert4To8 -> pixcmapConvertTo8 called (pixconv.c:2569)

fine_trace.note: Returns pix1->colormap — a raw pointer to the PIXCMAP allocated in step 2. pixGetColormap (pix1.c:1611) returns the struct field directly with no copy and no ownership transfer. The fuzzer's local cmap now aliases pix1's internal colormap without owning it.

Destroys pix1: pixDestroy (pix1.c:615) -> pixFree (pix1.c:645) -> pixDestroyColormap (pix1.c:1662) -> pixcmapDestroy frees the PIXCMAP's array and the PIXCMAP struct itself (colormap.c:292-293), then sets pix->colormap = NULL. The fuzzer's local cmap is not updated and now holds a dangling pointer to the freed 24-byte PIXCMAP.

The cleanup passes the still-dangling local cmap alias to pixcmapDestroy after pixDestroy(&pix1) already freed the owned PIXCMAP. This call loads the stale pointer and enters the second destruction that reaches the use-after-free sink.

depends_on.via: the raw cmap alias obtained from pix1 remains unchanged

fine_trace.note: Called from colorquant_fuzzer.cc:48 via pixcmapDestroy(&cmap). pcmap is &cmap (fuzzer local). *pcmap loads the dangling pointer (non-NULL since the fuzzer's cmap was never cleared after pix1 was destroyed). Reads cmap->array (8 bytes) from the freed PIXCMAP struct at offset 0. ASAN: heap-use-after-free READ of size 8 at the start of the freed 24-byte region.
reachability_checkpoints: pcmap != NULL (line 284: &cmap is a valid stack address)
*pcmap != NULL (line 289: dangling pointer is non-NULL, destruction logic proceeds to the UAF read)

allocation_context.description: PIXCMAP allocated via LEPT_CALLOC(1, sizeof(PIXCMAP)) in pixcmapCreate(8), called from pixcmapConvertTo8 during the 4bpp-to-8bpp conversion chain.

free_context.description: PIXCMAP freed via LEPT_FREE(cmap) in pixcmapDestroy, called from pixDestroyColormap <- pixFree <- pixDestroy <- LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput (colorquant_fuzzer.cc:37).

format.name: SPIX
format.contract: A valid SPIX-format image that pixReadMemSpix successfully parses into a non-NULL PIX object. Any such valid input triggers the bug because the cleanup code unconditionally calls pixcmapDestroy(&cmap) on a pointer already freed by the preceding pixDestroy(&pix1), which frees the colormap through its ownership chain.
